description: 皮尔斯防御 B07 — 长易位主动进攻

intro.popup_en: Castling, Lesson 3: Queenside castling is not only defensive. White's king shelters on c1, then the g- and h-pawns launch an attack. Sometimes the best defense is to attack.
intro.popup:
王车易位第3课
长易位不只是防御！
白方长易位后，王藏在c1
然后g4/h4/g5兵暴进攻
进攻就是最好的防御！

outro.popup_en: Queenside castling moves the king to c1 and activates the rook on a1, while the rook on d1 protects the center. White can immediately begin a kingside pawn storm with g4. Queenside castling combines king safety with an attack; speed is critical.
outro.popup:
长易位总结
① 长易位：王到c1，a1车自动激活
② d1车守中路
③ 易位后立刻g4开始冲兵
长易位 = 王安全加王翼进攻
速度就是一切！

moves.popup_en: e4 opens the game.
moves.popup: e4开局

moves.popup_en: ...d6 begins the Pirc Defense, a flexible response by Black.
moves.popup:
d6皮尔斯防御
黑方灵活应对

moves.popup_en: d4 establishes White's center.
moves.popup: d4建立中心

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops and counterattacks e4.
moves.popup:
Nf6发展
反击e4

moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops a knight.
moves.popup: Nc3发展

moves.popup_en: ...g6 prepares the fianchetto, a characteristic Pirc setup.
moves.popup:
g6准备象翼布阵
皮尔斯防御特征

moves.popup_en: Be3 develops and prepares the route to queenside castling.
moves.popup:
Be3发展象
准备长易位路线

moves.popup_en: ...Bg7 fianchettoes Black's bishop in a hypermodern setup.
moves.popup:
Bg7强力象
黑方超现代布局

moves.popup_en: Qd2! The queen prepares queenside castling and keeps the option of Bh6 to exchange Black's fianchettoed bishop.
moves.popup:
Qd2！
后到d2有双重目的：
1. 准备O-O-O长易位
2. Bh6兑换黑方Bg7

moves.popup_en: ...a6! Black prepares a queenside pawn storm with ...b5 and possibly ...b4.
moves.popup:
a6！黑方准备b5冲兵
b5以后还可以b4
后翼反击计划启动

moves.popup_en: f3 reinforces the center and prepares White's own g4 pawn storm.
moves.popup:
f3加固中心
同时准备g4冲兵

moves.popup_en: ...b5! Black begins the queenside counterattack.
moves.popup:
b5！黑方反击
后翼冲兵开始

moves.popup_en: O-O-O! White's king reaches the safe square c1, and the rook on d1 is immediately active. White can now attack on the kingside.
moves.popup:
O-O-O！白方长易位！
王到c1，安全！
注意：d1车立刻激活
现在白方可以全力进攻王翼！

moves.popup_en: ...Nbd7 develops while Black prepares for the coming attack.
moves.popup:
Nbd7发展马
黑方也在备战

moves.popup_en: g4! White immediately launches the kingside attack. With the king safe on c1, White can advance the g- and h-pawns aggressively.
moves.popup:
g4！冲兵进攻！
长易位后立刻发动王翼进攻
白方王在c1安全
可以毫无顾忌地推g/h兵

moves.popup_en: ...b4! Black counterattacks on the queenside. The opposite-wing race is underway, and speed matters.
moves.popup:
b4！黑方反冲
异侧对攻开始
速度决定胜负！

moves.popup_en: Nd5! White sacrifices a knight on a strong square, attacking Nf6. Black's a- and b-pawns do not control d5, so no pawn can capture it; this is a genuine attacking sacrifice.
moves.popup:
Nd5！马跳强格弃子！
c3马跳d5，攻击Nf6
黑方没有兵能吃（a6/b4都不控d5）
这是真正的进攻弃子！

moves.popup_en: ...Nxd5 accepts the exchange with the knight from f6.
moves.popup:
Nxd5黑马被迫兑换
Nf6×d5接受兑换

moves.popup_en: exd5! White recaptures with the e-pawn, opening the center.
moves.popup:
exd5！白兵吃回
e4兵推进到d5，中心打开

moves.popup_en: ...Nb6 retreats from d7 to avoid losing the knight, but White has gained attacking chances.
moves.popup:
Nb6马撤退
Nd7→b6，避免损失
但白方已获得进攻优势

moves.popup_en: Bh6! White exchanges Black's powerful fianchettoed bishop, weakening the defense around the king.
moves.popup:
Bh6！
消灭黑方龙象Bg7
黑王h8/g8一带防线削弱

moves.popup_en: ...Bxh6 is forced, exchanging the bishop.
moves.popup: Bxh6被迫兑换

moves.popup_en: Qxh6! The queen enters h6 and points directly at Black's king. The attacking value of queenside castling is now clear.
moves.popup:
Qxh6！后进驻h6
直逼黑王
长易位的进攻价值完全展现！
